title: A morphism of the bounded below derived category is an isomorphism iff it is so on cohomology
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category and $\Dplus(\mathcal A)$ its bounded below derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. A morphism $\varphi:K\to L$ of $\Dplus(\mathcal A)$ is an isomorphism if and only if the induced morphism $\mathcal H^n(\varphi):\mathcal H^n(K)\to\mathcal H^n(L)$ of cohomology objects is an isomorphism for every integer $n$.
